category.name: Finance, payments and market data
category.description: Accept payments, move money, access bank data and query stock, FX and crypto prices.

entries.name: Adyen API
entries.free_tier: paid only; requires a signed merchant contract, pay per-transaction
entries.desc_en: Process payments, payouts, and manage disputes/balances across global payment methods via REST API.
entries.notes: Requires an approved Adyen merchant account before API keys are issued; no self-serve free signup like Stripe. Official local MCP server (alpha) covers Checkout and Management APIs.

entries.name: Alpaca Trading API
entries.free_tier: free paper trading (unlimited); free basic (IEX) market data feed
entries.desc_en: Place stock/options/crypto trades and stream market data via REST/WebSocket API, with free paper trading.
entries.notes: Commission-free live trading requires a funded brokerage account (US persons/entities eligibility rules apply).

free_plan.quota: Paper trading free for all users; Basic market data (IEX) 200 API calls/min

rate_limits.summary: Free Basic market data plan: 200 API calls/min, websocket limited to 30 symbols

call.async: fills happen later; poll GET https://paper-api.alpaca.markets/v2/orders/{order_id} or stream trade_updates

entries.name: Alpha Vantage
entries.desc_en: Fetch stock, forex, crypto prices and technical/fundamental indicators via a free REST API.
entries.notes: Free tier is limited to 25 requests/day; paid Premium plans needed for real-time/higher volume. Remote MCP signs in via OAuth; the ?apikey= URL parameter is deprecated.

entries.name: Coinbase (CDP / x402)
entries.auth_hint: CDP API Key ID/Secret, JWT-signed bearer requests
entries.free_tier: Free tier: CDP x402 Facilitator free for 1,000 onchain transactions/month, then $0.001/tx; payment verification always free
entries.desc_en: Create wallets, send crypto, and pay per-API-call with stablecoins over HTTP (x402) via the Coinbase Developer Platform SDK.
entries.notes: x402 is an open HTTP-402 payment protocol Coinbase champions, not a single vendor API. Official local Payments MCP (npx @coinbase/payments-mcp) signs in with an email-based browser wallet, not the CDP API key.

free_plan.quota: 1,000 onchain transactions via CDP x402 Facilitator, then $0.001/tx

auth_scheme.format: Authorization: Bearer <JWT signed with CDP Secret API Key> (+ X-Wallet-Auth: <wallet JWT> for wallet writes)

unit_price.summary: Server Wallet: $0.005 per wallet operation (account creation = 1 op), first 5,000 ops/month free; x402 facilitator: $0.001 per settled tx after 1,000 free/month, verification free

entries.name: CoinGecko API
entries.auth_hint: x-cg-demo-api-key or x-cg-pro-api-key header; keyless via the free MCP endpoint
entries.free_tier: Free tier: Demo API plan 10,000 calls/month, 100 calls/min, attribution required; keyless free MCP with shared rate limits
entries.desc_en: Fetch live and historical crypto prices, market data, and NFT data via REST API or the official CoinGecko MCP server.
entries.notes: Free MCP endpoint (mcp.api.coingecko.com) requires no key, just shared rate limits; keyed endpoint mcp.pro-api.coingecko.com/mcp asks for your API key via browser sign-in (OAuth).

rate_limits.summary: Demo plan: 100 calls/min; keyless access is IP-rate-limited and shared

unit_price.summary: 1 request = 1 call credit; paid plans from $35/mo for 100k credits; overage $0.0005 per call

entries.name: CoinMarketCap API
entries.auth_hint: Header X-CMC_PRO_API_KEY: <API_KEY> (keyless public API under https://pro-api.coinmarketcap.com/public-api/... needs no key; MCP uses header X-CMC-MCP-API-KEY)
entries.free_tier: Free Basic plan: 15,000 credits/month, 50 requests/min, 1 API key, commercial use allowed; plus a keyless public API with lower rate limits
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent fetch live and historical cryptocurrency prices, market caps, listings, exchange and DEX data, and indices like Fear & Greed.
entries.notes: Basic plan covers core endpoints only (many historical endpoints are paid). Remote MCP over streamable HTTP; also x402 pay-per-request endpoints.

call.operation: get latest price quotes for coins

unit_price.summary: x402 pay-per-request: $0.01 USDC per API request (no key needed)

entries.name: DexPaprika DEX API
entries.auth_hint: No key needed on https://api.dexpaprika.com; optional free key sent as the whole header value: Authorization: <API_KEY>
entries.free_tier: No key; 30,000 credits per rolling 30 days per IP at 15 requests/min. Free registered key: 100,000 credits/30 days at 30 requests/min, no card
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent query on-chain DEX data across 36 blockchains: liquidity pools, swaps, token prices, OHLCV history and live price streams.
entries.notes: Keyless hosted MCP (also SSE at https://mcp.dexpaprika.com/sse). Batch endpoints cost 1 credit per item; HTTP 402 when the monthly allowance runs out.

free_plan.quota: No key needed; free API key gives 100K credits/month at 30 requests/min

auth_scheme.format: No auth required; optional key as full header value: Authorization: api_YOUR_KEY

rate_limits.summary: Free key: 100K credits/month, 30 requests/min; 1 request = 1 credit (batch = 1 credit per item)

call.operation: get a token's latest price and metrics

unit_price.summary: 1 credit per request (batch endpoints 1 per item); Dev 500k / Pro 5M credits per month included, then $20 per additional 1M credits; free: 30k credits per 30 days without key

entries.name: Financial Modeling Prep
entries.desc_en: Fetch company financials, stock prices, and fundamental data via a REST API.
entries.notes: Many endpoints (full financial statements, etc.) require a paid plan. Official hosted MCP takes the key as ?apikey=<API_KEY>.

free_plan.quota: 250 calls/day, end-of-day data, 500MB trailing-30-day bandwidth (Basic plan)

rate_limits.summary: Free Basic plan: 250 calls/day; 500MB bandwidth per trailing 30 days

entries.name: Mercado Pago API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> (test or production access token from Your integrations; OAuth for acting on behalf of sellers)
entries.free_tier: Free to integrate: no API or monthly fees, only per-transaction commissions; free test credentials and test users for sandbox payments
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent create checkout preferences, payments, refunds and subscriptions and look up transactions in Latin America's Mercado Pago.
entries.notes: Available in Latin American countries (AR, BR, MX, CL, CO, PE, UY); live payments need a verified Mercado Pago account. Remote MCP uses OAuth and focuses on docs search, app/credential management, webhooks, test users and integration quality.

free_plan.quota: Test credentials usable immediately after creating an application (sandbox); production billed per transaction

call.operation: create a Checkout Pro payment preference

entries.name: Open Exchange Rates
entries.free_tier: free tier: 1,000 requests/month, USD base only, hourly updates
entries.desc_en: Fetch current and historical foreign-exchange rates for 200+ currencies via a REST API.
entries.notes: Free plan is restricted to USD as the base currency; multi-base conversion requires a paid plan.

free_plan.quota: 1,000 requests/month, hourly updates, USD base only

entries.name: PayPal API
entries.auth_hint: OAuth2 client-credentials Bearer token; MCP also supports an access-token env var
entries.free_tier: free to integrate; pay per-transaction fees only; sandbox for testing
entries.desc_en: Process payments, payouts, invoices, and subscriptions via REST API or PayPal's official MCP server.
entries.notes: Remote MCP: https://mcp.paypal.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth login) or /sse; docs still list /http, which returns 404. Sandbox MCP at https://mcp.sandbox.paypal.com for testing.

free_plan.quota: Sandbox test environment with virtual accounts; live usage billed per transaction

rate_limits.summary: No published limits; abusive traffic gets HTTP 429 RATE_LIMIT_REACHED; cache OAuth tokens, prefer webhooks over polling

call.operation: create a checkout order (access token from POST /v1/oauth2/token)
call.async: buyer approves at the payer-action link; then POST /v2/checkout/orders/{id}/capture

unit_price.summary: US domestic PayPal Checkout: 3.49% + $0.49 per transaction (standard card payments 2.99% + $0.49)

entries.name: Plaid API
entries.free_tier: Trial: Sandbox always free; new US/Canada teams (since 2026-04-15) get a free Trial plan with up to 10 Production Items one-time; then pay-as-you-go
entries.desc_en: Link bank accounts and fetch balances, transactions, and identity data via REST API/SDKs.
entries.notes: Dashboard MCP (OAuth client_credentials, scope mcp:dashboard) needs Production access; a local Sandbox MCP is in plaid/ai-coding-toolkit. Production requires a Plaid approval/compliance review.

free_plan.quota: Free Sandbox; Trial plan (new US/Canada teams since 2026-04-15): 10 Production Items, unlimited calls on them

auth_scheme.name: PLAID-CLIENT-ID
auth_scheme.format: PLAID-CLIENT-ID: <CLIENT_ID> and PLAID-SECRET: <SECRET> (or client_id/secret in JSON body)

rate_limits.summary: Per-Item and per-client limits per endpoint, e.g. /accounts/get 15/min per Item, 15,000/min per client; HTTP 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED

call.operation: sync transactions for a linked Item

entries.name: Polygon.io / Massive
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <api_key> or apiKey query param
entries.free_tier: free tier available (delayed data, limited calls/min); paid plans for real-time
entries.desc_en: Query real-time and historical stocks, options, forex, and crypto market data via REST/WebSocket API.
entries.notes: Polygon.io rebranded to 'Massive' in 2026; the old polygon.io domain now redirects there. Massive also offers an MCP server for AI tools.

free_plan.quota: Stocks Basic: 5 API calls/min, end-of-day data, 2 years history

call.operation: get the previous day OHLC bar for a stock

entries.name: Square API
entries.free_tier: free to integrate; pay per-transaction processing fees; free Sandbox for testing
entries.desc_en: Process in-person/online payments, manage orders, invoices, and catalog via REST API and SDKs.
entries.notes: Requires a Square merchant account; Sandbox environment is free for development/testing. Missing from candidate list despite being a major agent-callable payments API.

free_plan.quota: Unlimited free Sandbox API calls; production billed per transaction

rate_limits.summary: No published numbers; bursts may get HTTP 429 RATE_LIMITED; use backoff and batch endpoints

unit_price.summary: US online/API card payment: 2.9% + 30c per transaction

entries.name: Stripe API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <secret_key>; from 2026-10-31 MCP accepts only OAuth or Agent-tagged API keys (others get 401)
entries.free_tier: free to integrate; pay per-transaction fees only, no monthly fee
entries.desc_en: Create payments, subscriptions, invoices, and refunds programmatically via REST API or the official Stripe MCP server.
entries.notes: From Oct 31, 2026, Stripe MCP requires an 'Agent' API key or OAuth - full-access/restricted keys without the Agent tag stop working.

free_plan.quota: No setup or monthly fees; pay per transaction; free sandbox (test mode)

auth_scheme.format: curl -u <SECRET_KEY>: (key as username) or Authorization: Bearer <SECRET_KEY>

rate_limits.summary: Global 100 req/s live, 25 req/s sandbox; 25 req/s per endpoint; reads capped at avg 500 per transaction (min 10,000/month)

unit_price.summary: Poland account, standard EEA cards: 1.5% + 1.00 zł per successful card transaction (rates vary by country)

entries.name: Wise API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <API token> (personal, Wise business accounts) or OAuth2 (Wise Platform partners)
entries.free_tier: free API access; normal Wise transfer fees apply per transaction; sandbox available
entries.desc_en: Send international transfers, check exchange rates, and manage multi-currency balances via REST API.
entries.notes: Personal tokens cover only quotes, recipients, transfers, batch groups and transfer events; funding and balance statements only for US/CA/AU/NZ/SG/MY accounts. Full access needs a partnership agreement. Docs use versioned paths, e.g. https://api.wise.com/2026Q3/profiles/{profileId}/quotes

free_plan.quota: Personal API token created from a Wise business account; limited endpoints

call.operation: create a transfer quote (rate and fees)
